claims.claim: Very sound and working fine borehole drilling machine
claims.evidence: No video of engine start, rig operation, or drilling test; only static photos showing rust and dust.

claims.claim: Buy to site condition for very serious buyers
claims.evidence: Sales framing, not a physical claim the photos can confirm.
Windshield stickers reading 'BENT PA(?)D STEERING' and 'NO HAND SIGNAL' hint at possible known faults, but text is partly illegible; no operational footage provided.
No service receipt, sticker, or dealer stamp visible in any photo.
Hydraulic hoses and drill rods are visible, but no close-up confirms completeness of rig components or tool inventory.
Cab badge confirms Nissan Diesel brand, but the drilling rig itself only shows partial 'FR' lettering, not a full manufacturer nameplate; rig could be aftermarket-mounted.

risks.risk: Engine and drivetrain may not start or run reliably
risks.proof: Video of cold start, idle, and short drive

risks.risk: Drilling rig hydraulics/compressor may not function
risks.proof: Video of rig mast raising and drill rotation under power
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-functional rig, parts-value only

risks.proof: Clear photo of odometer and VIN/chassis plate
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage/old chassis worst case

risks.proof: Photo of service invoices or maintenance logbook
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no-service-history, assume deferred maintenance

risks.proof: Photo of vehicle particulars, registration papers, valid plate

risks.risk: Steering or signaling fault implied by windshield warning stickers
risks.proof: Clear legible photo/video of the stickers and a steering test clip
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a steering defect

risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tyre treads and sidewalls
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn tyres needing replacement

risks.risk: Drilling rig brand/model unverified, may be generic/rebuilt
risks.proof: Clear photo of rig manufacturer nameplate/serial number
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unbranded/generic rig, lower resale value

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running
Video of drilling rig mast raising/lowering and rotating under hydraulic power
Photo of chassis/VIN plate and rig manufacturer nameplate
Photo of vehicle registration/particulars and current roadworthiness certificate
Photo of any service receipts or maintenance records
Close-up legible photo of windshield warning stickers
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nissan Diesel-based water well drilling rig truck, so identity is settled, but no claim of working condition, service, or completeness is supported by the photos, and warning stickers plus rust suggest real faults; price at worst case pending the listed proofs.
